head: 67649ac74fce206654b307db2a6feb082da2f3bf
claim: A person with two cloud accounts and three managed computers can list them, pick the active account, sleep and wake one computer without touching the others, and remove one

verdicts.seen: Read all 3 managed entries and every listed record. Accounts show Work and Home with active=acct-work. Sleeping beta changed only it (alpha on, beta asleep, gamma on), and waking beta restored it. Removing alpha left managed as [beta, gamma] and alpha-now is no-machine. EXIT=0. The refused-add line is an unrelated event and does not contradict the outcome. The capture does not show an explicit account-selection action, which keeps the unclear weight non-trivial.
